scope: Host native terrain dirty-page recomposition and source cache preservation; controlled synthetic production fixtures, not hardware/game FPS proof
engine_pe_sha_abi_offsets: Not applicable to host cache algorithm; existing material/light sources unchanged
failure_mode: A single ore overlayFrame change invalidated the whole native terrain bank before GPU xBRZ could begin

controlled_profile.fixture: Synthetic 128x128 legal diamond map,60x30 TMP about900 opaque pixels,one12x12 ore overlayFrame change
controlled_profile.timing_scope: complete CPU SceneRenderer calls including final CPU xBRZ/output, not native35-cell-only timing or game FPS
controlled_profile.limitation: Small synthetic CPU sample, no broad timing guarantee or user stutter sole-cause proof

native_pages.replay: all original-order underlay/TMP/overlay sources intersecting selected complete pages, including attachments and shadows
native_pages.target_write_clip: coverage rounded to native page bounds; conservative source reach unchanged

source_cache.invalidated: only source footprints intersecting complete dirty native pages
source_cache.gpu_effect: unaffected resident texture/xBRZ owners remain reusable

native_repaint.oracle: complete colors and bitwise float Z equal full repaint including deletion, NaN, shadow, underlay and occlusion; original bank unchanged

terrain_partial_scene.oracle: fresh full production SceneRenderer after every partial and full-guard change, native and1.5x output
cases: current local/global light and palette full rebuild guards

limits: No actual hardware GPU or live-game FPS measurement
CPU game reads/validation, decode, pose/VPL and bounded native terrain work remain
Final GPU-to-CPU RGBA/mask readback and Win32 layered-window presentation remain
Broad source/light changes or exceeded partial budget retain original full rebuild
Synthetic profile cannot establish sole cause of user-reported periodic stutter
